states.regression: A finding was previously verified fixed and later reopened.
states.latent-defect: An open finding predates the reviewed change and has no prior verified repair.
states.ruled-out-historical: The current resolution record rules the finding out; it is retained as history.
states.unverified-suspicion: A candidate concern has no finding authority.
states.unknown: An open question records an unresolved judgment, not a defect claim.
